appliance.policy: scanner3d.reconstruction_export.choose_tsdf_resolution over the case's own measured points at the desktop Reconstruct action's voxel budget (scanner3d.gui.RECONSTRUCT_VOXEL_BUDGET, 128 ** 3), fused and extracted with the constants scanner3d.reconstruction_export ships

selection_rule: the recommended cell is the one with the highest analytic.reference_coverage_fraction over the dense exact sampling of the scene's own shapes. Ties break on the lower analytic.distances.p95, then the lower field.work_units, then the lexicographically first cell_id. It is applied to EVERY declared cell after all of them have run; a case that did not run a declared cell is refused before any cell is chosen. The derived shipped-policy arm is reported beside the winner and is never eligible to be it, because its resolution is not a choice the grid offers.
units: Lengths are synthetic depth units: raw code times depth scale, exact by construction. No physical length is implied anywhere in this corpus.
what: Exact-truth multi-view scenes for comparing the measured point cloud with the raw TSDF surface extracted from the same frames and the same poses, one perturbation at a time.
why: The fused surface looks lumpier and less complete than the measured dots. This corpus separates raw depth noise, localized outliers, structured no-return loss, translational pose error, rotational pose error and their interaction as causes of that, against exact truth and a predeclared parameter grid, so a fix is chosen from evidence rather than by eye.
